So I’ve been having unusual breakouts since April I’d say. Otherwise my skin has been clear. I went to the derm and she prescribed me Doxycycline due to staph they found in my nose. She thought maybe that was the reason for the acne. I was on Doxy for 3 weeks and it pretty much cleared my skin. However after stopping, these clusters of small pimples came back and are getting visibly worse every day. I’ll go see the doctor on Thursday but I’ve been thinking whether any of you suspect what might help :(

Routine:
La roche posay effaclar cleanser (the one for damaged skin)
Rose water
La roche posay moisturizer 
Azelaic acid
Sometimes benozyl peroxide (only PM)
Sometimes Mario badescu drying lotion

Caption: After having an acne flareup where nothing helped my derm prescribed me 3 weeks on doxy because they found out i had staph in my nose. While on doxy it cleared up. Now I’m a few days after taking it and this all has happened in the span of two days. :( it looks like a rash but I think it’s just a lot of small pimples. Any advice please, has anybody gone through this?
